SQL:
WITH __slayer_stage_cr AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.regions.name" AS "customers__regions__name",
    _stage_inner."orders.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.revenue" AS "revenue"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
      orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
      ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
    LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
      ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
    WHERE
      NOT customers.region_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      customers__regions.name,
      orders.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."cr.customers__regions__name" AS "customers__regions__name",
    _stage_inner."cr.revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name" AS "revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      cr.customers__regions__name AS "cr.customers__regions__name",
      SUM(cr.revenue) AS "cr.revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name"
    FROM __slayer_stage_cr AS cr
    GROUP BY
      cr.customers__regions__name
  ) AS _stage_inner
), base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    cr.customer_id AS "cr.customer_id",
    cr.customers__regions__name AS "cr.customers__regions__name",
    MAX(cr.revenue) AS "cr.revenue_max_partition_by_customer_id_customers__regions__name"
  FROM __slayer_stage_cr AS cr
  GROUP BY
    cr.customer_id,
    cr.customers__regions__name
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "cr.customer_id",
    "cr.customers__regions__name",
    "cr.revenue_max_partition_by_customer_id_customers__regions__name",
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY "cr.customers__regions__name"
      ORDER BY "cr.revenue_max_partition_by_customer_id_customers__regions__name" DESC
    ) AS "cr.rank"
  FROM base_2
), _cm_rank AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."cr.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."cr.customers__regions__name" AS "customers__regions__name",
    _stage_inner."cr.rank" AS "rank"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "cr.customer_id",
      "cr.customers__regions__name",
      "cr.rank"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        "cr.customer_id",
        "cr.customers__regions__name",
        "cr.revenue_max_partition_by_customer_id_customers__regions__name",
        "cr.rank"
      FROM step1
    ) AS _outer
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  cr.customers__regions__name AS "cr.customers__regions__name",
  cr.customer_id AS "cr.customer_id",
  cr.revenue AS "cr.revenue",
  _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name."revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name" AS "cr.region_total",
  _cm_rank."rank" AS "cr.rk"
FROM __slayer_stage_cr AS cr
LEFT JOIN _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name
  ON cr.customers__regions__name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name."customers__regions__name"
LEFT JOIN _cm_rank
  ON cr.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_rank."customer_id"
  AND cr.customers__regions__name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_rank."customers__regions__name"
WHERE
  _cm_rank."rank" <= 2
GROUP BY
  cr.customers__regions__name,
  cr.customer_id,
  cr.revenue,
  _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name."revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name",
  _cm_rank."rank"
ORDER BY
  "cr.customers__regions__name" ASC,
  "cr.revenue" DESC
LIMIT 21

args.message: Here are the two highest-revenue customers in each region, with each region's total revenue shown on the same rows. Revenue is the sum of order amounts, and orders of every status are included. I left out the one customer with no region and any orders that don't match a customer. Arctic is in the regions table but has no customers, so it doesn't appear.
